column5: After the death of a skilled weaver named Knowles from Dean Combe, his ghost appears weaving at his loom until a priest forces him to leave. As punishment for his worldly desires, the weaver's spirit is transformed into a hound and condemned to an eternal task at Hound's Pool.

column3: The Gwyllgi, Or Dog Of Darkness.
column5: The frightful apparition of a mastiff with blazing red eyes, known as the Gwyllgi, haunted Pant y Madog near Laugharne, Carmarthenshire, terrifying a woman named Rebecca Adams as it approached her and emitted an earth-shaking scream. This spectral dog is said to still haunt Carmarthenshire, as reported by witnesses in Llangynog who have seen such apparitions.

column3: A Familiar Spirit In The Shape Of A Dog And The Lonely Night Traveller.
column5: A man from Cilcwm was returning home late at night through a lonely mountainous area when he encountered a friendly black dog walking beside him. Upon reaching home, the dog mysteriously vanished, leading the man to believe it was a familiar spirit sent by a wizard to keep him company on his journey.

A shaggy phantom hound known as Owd Rugman haunted the rural lanes and villages of Attlebridge and Lenwade during the late nineteenth century. Local residents reported numerous frightening encounters with this spectral beast as it roamed the countryside. hound

column3: The Bexwell Shuck and the Rector's Hound
column5: Around 1870, the Bexwell parish clerk encountered a terrifying black dog vanishing through a hedge with a loud rattling of chains and a smell of sulphur along the road to Downham Market. Although the local rector suggested the beast was simply his own escaped hound, he was left entirely puzzled by the supernatural stench. approx hound

column3: The Phantom Newfoundland of Roudham Heath
column5: A motorist driving across Roudham Heath late at night encountered a gigantic, supernatural Newfoundland dog crossing the ancient Peddar's Way. Upon returning home, his mother immediately recognized the apparition as Old Shuck. hound

column3: The Guardian Hound of Catfield Marshes
column5: While illegally gathering rushes on the marshes near Catfield Hall, a group of women fleeing a gamekeeper were guided safely home by a mysterious black dog. private hound

column3: The Phantom Hound of Coltishall Bridge
column5: Multiple residents and travellers have reported encountering a massive, silent black dog with glowing eyes lurking around Coltishall Bridge after dark. Over the decades, terrified witnesses have watched the monstrous phantom hound materialize, cross their path, and vanish into thin air. dog

A woman walking back to Geldeston along the market path with her daughter and her companion encounters a terrifying, shapeshifting beast. The entity trails them before finally disappearing up the sandy lane leading to the churchyard. hound
While staying at her late great aunt's cottage in Weasenham, a recovering librarian is pursued by the spectral black hound Black Shuck along the misty autumn lanes near Weasenham Woods. approx hound

Legend tells of a terrifying black dog that stormed through St Mary's Church in Bungay on August 4th, 1577, killing worshippers and leaving scorch marks still visible today at Blythburgh Church—marks said to be the Devil’s own fingerprints. This spectral beast, known as the Bungay Black Dog, is said to haunt the lonely paths of the Suffolk Coast, silent in step but chilling in howl.

The Moddey Dhoo is a spectral black dog that haunts Peel Castle on the Isle of Man. According to legend, it appeared nightly in the guardroom, vanishing into a sealed passage after terrifying an overconfident guard.

Hainu is a winged dog from Japanese folklore, known for its strength, speed, and ferocity. According to legend, Hainu can be both menacing and loyal, and has been immortalized in the form of a stone monument and bronze statues in Chikugo City.
